title: Removing $m$ from $m$-pile Divisor Nim
summary: In Divisor Nim, a player removes from one heap a positive number of stones that divides the size of every other heap. We prove that the Sprague--Grundy (SG) value satisfies $g(P)\le 2h_{\min}+\lfloor\log_2h_{\min}\rfloor$, where $h_{\min}$ is the smallest nonempty heap, independently of the number and sizes of the other heaps. The proof starts with odd heaps and classifies removals by their factors of $2$. The largest heap in a starting board then supplies an SG bound valid throughout every successor chain.
